name: Shish Industries Limited
about: Shish Industries Limited engages in the manufacture, trading, and marketing of polypropylene (PP) sheets and rolls in India. The company provides industrial packaging, thermal insulation, PP/PE woven fabric and consumer products. It offers flexible intermediate bulk containers, air dunnage bags, composite straps, PP bubble rolls and corrugated sheets, and other packaging materials, as well as solutions for industrial and commercial applications, ventilation systems, and retention lining solutions. In addition, it engages in manufacturing polymer-based products, offering packaging solutions, and providing related services. The company serves agriculture, chemicals, warehousing, automotive, chemical, logistics, and construction and infrastructure industry. Shish Industries Limited was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Surat, India.
